# Keep large workspace restore previews easy to review

## What & Why
Large backups should still communicate what will be restored before the user confirms replacement. The current cancellation regression covers one answer and one opportunity, but it does not protect the summary counts, truncation text, or mixed status breakdown for a larger backup.

## Done looks like
- A browser test imports a backup with more than three answers and opportunities
- The restore dialog shows the correct counts and the expected “and N more” summary text
- Mixed application statuses are represented accurately before confirmation
- Confirming the preview still restores every validated item
